Wait, isn't buying a third pair of $249 headphones when I already have working Beats Pros and Sony XM4s super capitalist and wasteful?

message.content:
You make a valid point. Since you already have two high-quality headphones—the Beats Fit Pro and Sony WH-1000XM4—buying a third pair like the AirPods Pro 2 might be unnecessary and could be seen as wasteful, especially if you're trying to cut back on tech spending this quarter.

If the main issue is comfort during long study sessions, a more budget-friendly and sustainable option might be to try memory foam replacement tips for your Beats Fit Pro. They are designed to reduce ear soreness and cost only $14. Would you like me to add those to your cart instead?
